cases.id: hidden:validation and request dedupe leave no side effects
hidden:stacking policies honor caps and the exact expiry boundary
hidden:modifiers aggregate live stacks without any tick
hidden:tick accrual is exact and independent of tick frequency
hidden:dispel orders by priority age effect id and sequence
hidden:save load rebases time and keeps history and accrual cursor
server:status effect component is attached and authoritative
server:real locomotor and combat modifiers follow stacks dispel and expiry
server:damage over time changes real health and death clears everything
server:effects survive OnSave and OnLoad and component removal cleans up
